title: patch
summary: Replace exact matching text within a file.
purpose: Replace exact matching text within a file.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Path relative to the source root.

fields.name: old_string
fields.description: Exact text to replace. An empty string is forbidden.

fields.name: replace_all
fields.description: Whether to replace every match at once.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: Encoding used to read and write the file.

fields.name: base_sha256
fields.description: Optional. sha256 of the content your edit is based on (read's source_sha256, or the sha256 of the previous write/patch response). If the disk differs, 409 (reason=base_changed) and nothing is written.

fields.name: allow_mask_substitution
fields.description: true only when replacing original text with '***' is intended. Requires reason; recorded in the server audit log.

fields.name: allow_replacement_char
fields.description: true only when adding U+FFFD that is not on disk is intended. Requires reason.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why an allow_* flag is used. Required when a flag is true.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
Put investigation/debugging temporary files, dumps, and notes in this work token's scratch directory supplied in the ment; never leave them in the project source tree via write or patch.
After write, patch, move, or remove succeeds, summarize the changed source files in the task report.

continuation.ment: Record the changed files in the work report.

details: Matching uses exact text, not line numbers.
Untouched bytes are preserved, so files with different line endings do not become whole-file changes. Use this tool instead of write for partial edits.

sha256 in a success response is the hash of the stored file (use it as the next base_sha256). For .py/.json, post_write_check carries a syntax check. The masking/U+FFFD checks judge the whole changed lines, not just new_string.

errors.when: The file is missing, is a directory, or contains no exact old_string match.
Two or more matches exist without replace_all.
The resulting file exceeds the server limit.
The file is not text, old_string equals new_string, encoding fails, or the path escapes the source root.
This token does not have the write scope.
base_sha256 was sent and the disk content differs (reason=base_changed, details.current_sha256).
A line replaces original text with '***' (reason=masked_substitution_suspect, details.lines), or adds U+FFFD that is not on disk (reason=replacement_char_introduced). Line text is never echoed.
